name: Utakana
source:
Main character meets an unusual student who introduces herself as an angel.
After a while strange incidents involving girls start to happen at school. Then the angel girl comes to class as transfer student and joins the investigation. What's happening in this school...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-june-2002-kanade.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角遇見一名自稱天使的奇怪學生。
不久後，學校裡開始發生與少女有關的詭異事件。那名天使少女後來轉進他的班上，也加入調查。這所學校究竟發生了什麼……

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-june-2002-kanade.html]vndbreview[/url]]
